We supply the transformers, switchgear, generators, cooling systems, and other critical equipment needed to bring new power and compute capacity online. We shorten lead times and accelerate projects forward, removing the physical bottlenecks holding back the next generation of technological progress.

launches.tagline: Critical equipment, without the multi-year wait.
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We’re Adhik and Rohit, co-founders of[ Applied Kinetics](https://appliedkinetics.ai).

**TL;DR:** Data centers and energy projects can wait up to 3 years for the electrical equipment they need to go live. **Applied Kinetics is an AI-native manufacturer that builds transformers, switchgear, generators, and cooling systems to each project’s specs and delivers them to site.** We’re quoting pad-mount transformers built and tested in 7 weeks, against up to 65 on the open market.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xtZgwxJMQeA>

**The Problem**

AI demand is driving a massive buildout of power and compute capacity, but the supply chain behind it hasn’t kept up. A developer can have financing, land, and customers lined up, then still wait years for the transformers and switchgear that energize the site. Every week of delay can cost hundreds of thousands of dollars in lost revenue.

This equipment comes from a small number of manufacturers, many of them booked out for years. Developers often end up coordinating several suppliers at once, and the whole project waits on whichever one delivers last.

**Our Solution**

Applied Kinetics builds transformers, switchgear, generators, and cooling systems to each project’s specifications, and owns every order from spec to site. Our AI agents run the work in between: reviewing specs, scheduling production, tracking every order, and catching delays before they reach your schedule. 

1. **Share your requirements.** Send us your project’s specs and timeline. Our agents review them and schedule production across our manufacturing network in the United States, Europe, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific, wherever the build can start soonest.
2. **We build to your specs.** We manage design approvals and production. Our agents track every milestone, follow up with the factory floor, and flag slips early.
3. **We deliver and support.** We handle export, customs, independent QA near your site, freight, and post-delivery service.

Because production runs across our whole network, each build starts wherever there’s capacity, not at the back of a multi-year queue.

**The Team**

**Rohit Naras (CEO):** Computer Engineering at Georgia Tech. Worked on GPU telemetry at Crusoe.\
**Adhik Durga (CTO):** Computer Engineering at Georgia Tech. Previously built AI agents at IBM.

We started Applied Kinetics after seeing supply chain bottlenecks hold up AI infrastructure firsthand. Multi-gigawatt projects across the industry are now at risk because critical equipment can’t arrive in time. We’re building the AI-native manufacturer that gets it there.

**Our Ask**

* **Developing data centers or energy projects?** Email [rohit@appliedkinetics.ai](mailto:rohit@appliedkinetics.ai) with the equipment you need and your timeline.
* **Know developers, operators, EPC firms, or utilities waiting on equipment?** Please share this post. We’d love an introduction.

Learn more at[ ](https://appliedkinetics.ai)[appliedkinetics.ai](http://appliedkinetics.ai).
